hypotheses.justification: It is only used to get a second support point s so that planeExponentDifference r s ≠ 0 and a primitive direction v can be extracted. Without it, split on whether such an s exists. If it does, the existing proof applies unchanged. If not, then since r ∈ f.support, every s ∈ f.support equals r. Take v = Pi.single 0 1, which is nonzero. For s = r, planeExponentDifference r r = fun i => (r i:ℤ) - (r i:ℤ) = 0 = (0:ℤ) • v, so k = 0 works. The conclusion is therefore still true without the hypothesis, and the degenerate case is the singleton support {r}. The other hypotheses, hr and hnrank, stay in place.
